from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str = Field(..., description="Full name of the party as written in the document")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Role in the case, e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Respondent")

class FinancialDetail(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific monetary amount found in the judgment."""
    amount: float = Field(..., description="The numerical amount of the fee or compensation")
    currency: str = Field(default="CNY", description="The currency unit")
    description: str = Field(..., description="What the amount is for, e.g., Court Fee, Compensation, Penalty")
    bearer: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Who is responsible for paying or receiving this amount")

class Ruling(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific court order or decision action."""
    action_type: str = Field(..., description="The primary action, e.g., 'Dismiss', 'Revoke', 'Maintain'")
    detail: str = Field(..., description="The detailed text of the ruling order")
    reference_case_number: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Any case number referenced in this specific ruling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for extracted facts from a single legal document."""
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="All case numbers cited or assigned in the document")
    court_names: list[str] = Field(description="All court names mentioned in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties involved in the dispute")
    rulings: list[Ruling] = Field(description="The specific court orders and decisions made")
    financial_details: list[FinancialDetail] = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts related to the final decision")
    document_types: list[str] = Field(description="The type of legal document, e.g., Civil Judgment, Administrative Ruling")
